title: What should buyers confirm before sampling rigid gift boxes? - MUGE PACKAGING SourceBridge
company: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
buyer_question: What should buyers confirm before sampling rigid gift boxes?
buyer_context: premium gifts, cosmetics, wellness sets, electronics and retail presentation boxes
short_answer: Before sampling, buyers should confirm whether the structure matches the product, sales channel and protection requirement. For rigid gift boxes, useful checks include box structure and closure style, insert or tray requirement, surface finish reference, product weight, presentation and shipping route.
